module: Core of the level editor's ImGui interface: management of tool windows (registration, show/hide, groups, modals, saving/loading the layout state), the presentation loop (`presentGui`: main dockspace then onEditorGui* hooks), the icon atlas (`editor.icons`) and a large number of `editor.ui*` wrappers around ImGui widgets (drag, input, slider, color) that additionally fill an `editEnded` BoolPtr when editing ends. An editor tool modder uses it to declare their windows (`editor.registerWindow`, `editor.beginWindow`/`endWindow`) and draw their widgets. `initialize` installs everything on the `editor` object.
usage:
-- onEditorInitialized
editor.registerWindow("myToolWindow", imgui.ImVec2(300, 200))
-- onEditorGui
if editor.beginWindow("myToolWindow", "My Tool") then
  -- widgets...
end
editor.endWindow()
notes: The whole API is exposed as editor.xxx (installed by initialize); the editEnded parameters are optional imgui.BoolPtr.
endWindow/endModalWindow must always be called, even if beginWindow returned false.
Modal windows are saved as invisible; they only reappear with openModalWindow.
The comment of showWindow says "sets the visible boolean to false" while the function sets visibility to true (or to `show`).
uiIconImageButton without a label generates an automatic per-frame id; pass an explicit `id` if the number/order of buttons changes.
The getTemp* helpers share one buffer per type: do not keep the pointer beyond the widget call.

Emitted hooks: onEditorGui(dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw), onEditorGuiMainMenu, onEditorGuiToolBar, onEditorGuiStatusBar, onEditorToolWindowShow/Hide/GotFocus/LostFocus(windowName), onEditorSaveWindowsState, onEditorLoadWindowsState, onEditorSaveGuiInstancerState, onEditorLoadGuiInstancerState, onWindowResized(ImVec2).

initialize.desc: Remembers the editor, initializes the state and installs all the functions below on `editor`.

presentGui.desc: Presents the whole editor interface: resyncs editor.keyModifiers from ImGui, creates the main dockspace, then emits onEditorGuiMainMenu, onEditorGuiToolBar, onEditorGui(dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw), onEditorGuiStatusBar and checks for resizing. Called every frame by the editor.

uiPlotLines1.desc: Wrapper of imgui.PlotLines1: float curve; default values offset 0, scale FLT_MAX, stride sizeof(float); auto_resize fits the size to the window.

auto_resize.desc: fill the window if graph_size is nil

IsItemDoubleClicked.desc: True if the last item is hovered and double-clicked.

IsItemClicked.desc: True if the last item is hovered and the button was just clicked.

uiInputSearch.desc: Search field (magnifier icon + text + clear button) of fixed width. Returns true if the text changed or was cleared.

editEnded.desc: if provided, receives true when editing has just ended (IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit)

uiInputSearchTextFilter.desc: Like uiInputSearch but edits an ImGuiTextFilter and rebuilds it (ImGuiTextFilter_Build) on each change.

editEnded.desc: if provided, receives true when editing has just ended (IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit)

uiInputFile.desc: File path field with a '...' button opening editor_fileDialog.openFile; writes the chosen path into buf.

dir.desc: initial folder (default: folder of the current path)

editEnded.desc: if provided, receives true when editing has just ended (IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit)

returns.desc: true if the text or file changed

uiRenderAlternateRows.desc: Draws alternating-color background rows in the current window/child (technique from ocornut/imgui#2668). Must be wrapped in Begin/BeginChild ... End/EndChild.

setKeyModifier.desc: Records the state of a modifier key in editor.keyModifiers (called by the editor's action map). Note: presentGui resyncs ctrl/shift/alt every frame from ImGui.

uiTextUnformattedRightAlign.desc: Displays text right-aligned in the available area.

uiTextColoredWithFont.desc: Displays text (colored if color is not nil) with a named ImGui font.

uiButtonRightAlign.desc: Right-aligned button in the available area.

uiIconImage.desc: Draws an icon from the editor atlas (32x32 size by default, multiplied by imgui.uiscale).

returns.desc: true if the image returned a click

uiIconImageButton.desc: Icon button (with or without a label). Without a provided id, an automatic per-frame id is generated. onRelease = click detected on release.

uiHighlightedText.desc: Displays text, highlighting in yellow several occurrences (case-insensitive, about ten at most) of highlightText.

uiHelpButton.desc: Help button: opens https://documentation.beamng.com/<relativeUrl> in the browser (index by default).

uiVertSeparator.desc: Draws a vertical separator on the current line.

texObj.desc: Loads a texture and returns its information; nil if loading fails.

returns.desc: {file, path, tex, texId (legacy, do not use), size, format}

getDefaultIconButtonSize.desc: Returns the default size of icon buttons.

setDefaultIconButtonSize.desc: Sets the default (square) size of icon buttons.

createIconAtlas.desc: Loads the editor icon atlas (JSON + image) and fills editor.icons, editor.atlasWidth, editor.atlasHeight. Logs duplicate icons.

showVizHelperWindow.desc: Opens the visibility help window (editor_vizHelper) if the extension is loaded.

drawBrush.desc: Draws a brush ('ellipse' type or box) on the ground around pos, stuck to the terrain (terrainBlock) or to static geometry by raycast.

checkWindowResize.desc: Detects a change in the main window size and emits the onWindowResized(ImVec2 DisplaySize) hook.

isViewportHovered.desc: True if the mouse is over the game's 3D view only (no ImGui item or window hovered).

isViewportFocused.desc: True if no ImGui item is active.

getSceneViewportRightEdge.desc: Returns the X coordinate of the right edge of the 3D view at the given screen height, taking right-docked windows into account.

returns.desc: x coordinate of the right edge

screenToClient.desc: Converts a screen point to a client point via the Canvas (identity if ImGui viewports are disabled).

registerWindow.desc: Registers a tool window (to be called in onEditorInitialized). Keeps the previous visibility if it already exists.

registerModalWindow.desc: Registers a modal window (shortcut for registerWindow with modal = true).

unregisterWindow.desc: Unregisters a window so that it is no longer in the saved state. To be called right after imgui.Begin if the window is no longer visible; to simply hide it, use hideWindow.

isWindowRegistered.desc: True if the window is registered.

isWindowVisible.desc: True if the window is registered and visible; also triggers the Show/Hide hooks if the visibility changed (e.g. closed with the cross).

getWindowVisibleBoolPtr.desc: Returns the window's visibility imgui.BoolPtr (used by imgui.Begin), or nil.

hideWindow.desc: Hides the window and emits onEditorToolWindowLostFocus then onEditorToolWindowHide.

hideAllWindows.desc: Hides all visible registered windows (emits the hooks).

showWindow.desc: Shows (or hides if show == false) the window and emits onEditorToolWindowShow / onEditorToolWindowHide.

setWindowGroupVisibility.desc: Shows or hides all the windows of a group.

setWindowGroup.desc: Changes the group of a registered window.

setupWindow.desc: Applies default size and position (Cond_FirstUseEver, or centering); to be called before imgui.Begin. Can force expansion according to the ui.general.forceExpandWindowOnFirstShow preference.

checkWindowFocus.desc: Detects the gain/loss of focus of the current ImGui window and emits onEditorToolWindowGotFocus / onEditorToolWindowLostFocus.

beginWindow.desc: Equivalent of imgui.Begin for a registered window (title##name). Returns false if not registered (warning) or invisible. Always to be paired with editor.endWindow().

returns.desc: true if the content must be drawn

endWindow.desc: Closes the window opened by beginWindow (calls imgui.End if Begin was called). To be called even if beginWindow returned false.

beginModalWindow.desc: Like beginWindow for a modal window: opens the popup if the window is marked visible.

returns.desc: true if the content must be drawn

endModalWindow.desc: Closes a modal window (imgui.EndPopup if it was displayed).

closeModalWindow.desc: Hides the modal window and closes the current ImGui popup.

saveWindowsState.desc: Saves the windows state (visibility, size, position, GUI instances) as JSON; modals are saved as invisible. Emits onEditorSaveGuiInstancerState and onEditorSaveWindowsState.

toolName.desc: only save the windows of this tool

loadWindowsState.desc: Reloads the windows state (falls back to settings/<tool>/layouts/Default/windowsState.json if the file is missing or has a different version), first hides all windows, then emits onEditorLoadWindowsState and onEditorLoadGuiInstancerState.

callShowWindowHookForVisibleWindows.desc: Emits onEditorToolWindowShow for each visible window.

defocusFocusedWindow.desc: Removes focus from the windows marked as focused (emits onEditorToolWindowLostFocus).

openModalDialog.desc: Opens a generic modal dialog (editorModalDialog window) whose content is drawn by uiFunction.

uiFunction.desc: function() called every frame to draw the content

closeModalDialog.desc: Closes the generic modal dialog and unregisters its window.

modalDialogWindowUi.desc: Draws the generic modal dialog; called by the editor.

getTempBool_BoolBool.desc: Helper for ImGui widgets: converts a Lua value into a reused temporary ImGui pointer (a single shared buffer per type, valid for the duration of one widget call). Conversion: bool -> bool pointer; nil -> bool read.

value.desc: value to convert, or nil to reread the buffer's value

getTempBool_StringString.desc: Helper for ImGui widgets: converts a Lua value into a reused temporary ImGui pointer (a single shared buffer per type, valid for the duration of one widget call). Conversion: string/bool -> bool pointer ("1" = true); nil -> "1" or "0".

value.desc: value to convert, or nil to reread the buffer's value
